question: Gopika Varma receives the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2018 for her contribution to _______
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohiniyattam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Gopika Varma** is a renowned exponent of the classical dance form, Mohiniyattam.
 
• She has contributed significantly to the **revival and popularization** of Mohiniyattam.
 
• Gopika Varma has received numerous awards for her contributions, including the prestigious **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** in 2018.
 
• Mohiniyattam is characterized by its **graceful movements and gentle, swaying body motions**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mohiniyattam**

 
 
• Mohiniyattam is one of the **eight classical dances of India**, originating from Kerala.
 
• The name Mohiniyattam comes from "Mohini", a divine enchantress avatar of the Hindu god Vishnu, and "attam", meaning dance.
 
• It is known for its **graceful and delicate** nature, with movements that are soft and lyrical.
 
• The dance form typically includes themes of **love and devotion**, often narrating stories from Hindu mythology.
 
 
 
• **Kathak**
 
 
• Kathak is another classical dance form of India, originating from the northern part of the country.
 
• It is known for its intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures and is often performed as a storytelling dance.
 
• Kathak has three main gharanas (schools): Jaipur, Lucknow, and Banaras.
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi**
 
 
• Kuchipudi is a classical Indian dance form that originated in the state of Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It is known for its fast rhythms and fluid movements, along with dramatic characterization.
 
• Kuchipudi typically includes both pure dance and expressive dance segments.
 
 
 
• **Odissi**
 
 
• Odissi is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, originating from the state of Odisha.
 
• It is characterized by its sculptural poses, fluid movements, and strong footwork.
 
• Odissi dance often depicts themes related to Lord Jagannath and other spiritual narratives.
